# telnyx_10dlc_phone_number_campaign (Resource)

The assignment of a phone number to a 10DLC campaign, which decides the registered campaign its A2P SMS traffic is sent under. Destroying it removes the number from the campaign.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_10dlc_phone_number_campaign" "main" {
  phone_number = "+15551230000"
  campaign_id  = telnyx_10dlc_campaign.alerts.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `campaign_id` (String) For shared campaigns, this is the TCR campaign ID, otherwise it is the campaign ID
- `phone_number` (String) The phone number in E.164 format.

### Read-Only

- `assignment_status` (String) The assignment status of the number.
- `brand_id` (String) Brand ID. Empty if the number is associated to a shared campaign.
- `created_at` (String)
- `failure_reasons` (String) Extra info about a failure to assign/unassign a number. Relevant only if the assignmentStatus is either FAILED_ASSIGNMENT or FAILED_UNASSIGNMENT
- `non_tmobile_number_mapping_status` (String) The assignment status of the number towards other carriers.
- `tcr_brand_id` (String) TCR's alphanumeric ID for the brand.
- `tcr_campaign_id` (String) TCR's alphanumeric ID for the campaign.
- `telnyx_campaign_id` (String) Campaign ID. Empty if the number is associated to a shared campaign.
- `tmobile_number_mapping_status` (String) The T-Mobile assignment status of the number.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_10dlc_phone_number_campaign.main +15551230000
```
